Its jati is sampurna-sampurna; it ascends N R G M' P D N S' and descends S' N D P M' G R S (M' is tivra Ma, S' is upper Sa). Tivra Ma is its only altered swara; every other swara is shuddha. It is one of the first ragas most students learn.
